title.th: ประกาศภาพยนตร์ (การยกเว้น) 2011

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Films (Exemption) Notification 2011 and shall come into operation on 15th September 2011.

2. In this Notification, unless the context otherwise requires —
“exempt film” means any obscene film that has been approved by the Authority for use by the exempt institution and any exempt person for educational and research purposes only;
[S 347/2019 wef 29/04/2019]
“exempt institution” means the Nanyang Technological University of Singapore;
“exempt person” means —
(a)Mr Adams Wai-Kin Kong for so long as he is employed by the exempt institution and deployed at the School of Computer Engineering; or
(b)any researcher who —
(i)is employed by the exempt institution or engaged by Mr Adams Wai-Kin Kong to assist Mr Adams Wai-Kin Kong in his research work; and
(ii)has received the approval of the Authority to use any exempt film for educational and research purposes;
[S 347/2019 wef 29/04/2019]
“use”, in relation to an exempt film, means to possess or exhibit the exempt film.

3. Subject to paragraphs 4 and 5, sections 29(2) and (4) and 30 of the Act shall not apply to, or in relation to, the exempt institution or any exempt person in respect of any exempt film that is used for educational or research purposes.

heading.en: Notification not to limit or affect other written law

text.en: 5. For the avoidance of doubt, nothing in this Notification shall be construed to limit or in any way affect the operation of any other written law in respect of any obscene film or in relation to any act in respect of any obscene film.
